postToolUse.bash: if command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then PYTHON_CMD=python; elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then PYTHON_CMD=python3; else PYTHON_CMD=''; fi; if [ -n "$PYTHON_CMD" ]; then "$PYTHON_CMD" -c "from pathlib import Path; Path('.akr/logs').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)"; else mkdir -p .akr/logs; fi; if [ "$TOOL_NAME" = "write_file" ] || [ "$TOOL_NAME" = "create_file" ] || [ "$TOOL_NAME" = "run_skill_script" ]; then TIMESTAMP=$(if [ -n "$PYTHON_CMD" ]; then "$PYTHON_CMD" -c "import datetime; print(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'))"; else date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"; fi 2>/dev/null || echo "unavailable"); SESSION_DATE=$(if [ -n "$PYTHON_CMD" ]; then "$PYTHON_CMD" -c "import datetime; print(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%d'))"; else date +"%Y%m%d"; fi 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown"); echo "{\"timestamp\": \"$TIMESTAMP\", \"tool\": \"$TOOL_NAME\", \"file\": \"$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH\"}" >> .akr/logs/session-$SESSION_DATE.jsonl; fi
